correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact indexed-word/closed-walk bijection using states abcd and edges abcd->bcde iff c=1_{a+b+d+e in {0,2}}. All 16 states split into two simple length-5 cycles, a recurrent 5-state component with 3- and 5-cycles, and one dead vertex; det(I-zA)=(1-z^5)^2(1-z^3-z^5). The logarithmic derivative yields precisely the labeled count, with the formal z^3 contribution removed for n>=5. Coin representation 3a+5b covers all n>=8, excluding n=7; primitive irreducible 5-state Perron component gives E_n/rho^n->1. Independent direct binary-state/trace and brute-force checks n=5..18 passed, but do not replace proof.
